About the ingredients: PDRN is investigated in laboratory skin-cell research. Niacinamide has been studied in topical formulations for the appearance of uneven tone and fine lines, while panthenol is studied for skin hydration. These ingredient roles help explain the formula without promising a recovery or treatment result.
Research cited here concerns ingredients or other formulations, not a clinical trial of this CELDYQUE product. PDRN research in cultured skin cells · Bissett et al. — Niacinamide and facial skin appearance · Gehring and Gloor — Dexpanthenol, hydration and barrier function
